# 1222700 A WAY OUT BYPASS

or Play using https://parsec.app/

---

## **​Launch the Game**:
```\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\AWayOut\Haze1\Binaries\Win64```
​Double-click `AWayOut.exe` inside game folder to start the game

## Skip this if Offline/SP
Install the Steam Demo:
1) Open your games installation folder
2) ​Double-click the `install_game.bat` file

Note: This adds the "Blastzone 2 Demo" to your Steam account, which is required to trick Steam into allowing Remote Play.
​Navigate to the Game

## ​Invite Your Friend:
1) ​Select the Play Local option in the main menu
2) ​Open the Steam Overlay by pressing SHIFT + TAB
3) ​Right-click your friend's name in your friends list and select Remote Play Together to invite them
